blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Titan Ultra resumed its PBA Governors’ Cup campaign on Sunday with a new coach in Raymond Valenzona. Valenzona was installed on an interim basis after the Giant Risers let go of Rensy Bajar, who has been calling the shots since the Commissioner’s Cup. The former multi-time champion coach for San Sebastian in the NCAA juniors, however, couldn’t steer the Giant Risers to victory as they were handed a 152-119 beating by the Converge FiberXers at Smart Araneta Coliseum.
